sinopsis.es: Una antigua institución para personas con discapacidad es ahora una polémica casa de los horrores gestionada por artistas con discapacidad. A medida que encarnan sus personajes, la verdadera historia de Pennhurst emerge.
sinopsis.en: A former institution for disabled people is now a controversial haunted house run by performers with disabilities. As they embrace their personas, the history of what Pennhurst actually was comes into sharper, more disturbing relief.
